added.title: אזהרה חמורה לסופרמרקטים בישראל: מערכות הקירור בסכנת מתקפה
added.summary: בעקבות גל מתקפות סייבר באירופה על מערכות קירור בסופרמרקטים שגרמו להשמדת מזון, מערך הסייבר הלאומי דורש מרשתות השיווק בישראל לבדוק את מערכות הבקרה שלהן ולהקשיח את ההגנה.

added.title: Oatly bets on fiber drinks to fuel plant-based turnaround
added.summary: Oatly is positioning itself as a functional beverage company focused on fiber, aiming to be among the leaders in reducing the fiber gap rather than just a milk alternative brand.

added.title: Mondelēz to acquire Undercover Snacks in expansion of better-for-you portfolio
added.summary: Mondelēz is acquiring the quinoa crisps brand Undercover Snacks as CEO Dirk Van de Put says the Oreo maker's portfolio needs to evolve towards healthier snacks.

added.title: Gut as core: Danone advances health span, early life nutrition in new China lab
added.summary: Danone has built a new research and innovation center in Shanghai to advance product solutions focused on gut microbiome, healthspan, and early-life nutrition for Chinese consumers.

added.title: Colombian Peso Breaks COP4,000 Peso Threshold, Local Coffee Price at Highest Since 2011
added.summary: The Colombian peso has crossed the COP4,000 threshold against the dollar, pushing local coffee prices to their highest level since 2011.

added.title: Biospringer by Lesaffre acquires ModuMax taste modulation tech from DSM-Firmenich
added.summary: Lesaffre's Biospringer unit has acquired the ModuMax taste modulation technology from DSM-Firmenich, expanding its ingredient portfolio for flavor and taste solutions.

added.title: From cultivated beef to fermented soy: Bezos-backed protein innovators target cost and scale
added.summary: Aleph Farms and Mottainai Food Tech each secured S$1m to scale cultivated meat and fermented protein production, aiming to reduce costs and improve commercial resilience.

added.title: הסנקציות על רוסיה הגיעו ל-KFC: זכיינית הרשת בישראל ביקשה צו חדלות פירעון
added.summary: זכיינית KFC בישראל, המפעילה 12 סניפים, מדווחת על חובות של כ-50 מיליון שקל בעיקר לבעלי מניות רוסים שאינם יכולים להזרים כסף נוסף בשל הסנקציות. בשישה סניפים כבר בוטלו הסכמי שכירות.

added.title: New cocoa powder alternative targets GLP-1 trends and supply risks
added.summary: Planet A Foods launched Cocoa Booster, a high-fiber cocoa powder replacer able to substitute up to 100% of cocoa in select applications amid rising costs and GLP-1-driven demand shifts.

added.title: No cows, no questions: FDA greenlights animal-free casein
added.summary: Those Vegan Cowboys and Formo receive an FDA no-questions letter for precision-fermented casein, advancing plans for US food and nutrition products.

added.title: Brazil election results put ag commodities under pressure
added.summary: Sugar and coffee prices diverged following Brazil's election results as the Brazilian real weakened, with ag commodity markets reacting broadly to the political outcome.

added.title: PepsiCo's Good Warrior enters protein bar space
added.summary: PepsiCo is boosting protein content across several brands via its Good Warrior line, with more than half of consumers prioritizing protein during snacking occasions.

added.title: כשברקע דיווחים על תוכנית לתקיפה באיראן: מחירי הנפט מזנקים משמעותית
added.summary: מחיר חבית ברנט רשם עלייה של כ-3% ונסחר סביב 112 דולר על רקע מתיחות גוברת באיראן. העלייה החדה במחירי האנרגיה עלולה להשפיע על עלויות ייצור והפצה במגזרים רבים.

added.title: Texas sues Nestlé's Gerber over alleged heavy metals in baby food
added.summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton is seeking more than $10 million in penalties from Nestlé's Gerber over alleged heavy metals in baby food.

added.title: Danone partners on $40M facility turning yogurt waste to renewable energy
added.summary: The project, commissioned by PurposeEnergy, comes as Danone boosts production to meet accelerating demand for high-protein yogurt.

added.title: Can plant proteins help ease the whey squeeze?
added.summary: With whey prices still more than double year-ago levels, ingredient suppliers including ADM are turning to plant proteins and hybrid formulations to meet rising protein demand.
